# @ramiidv/arca-agro - Technical Reference

## Overview

TypeScript SDK for ARCA (Argentina's tax authority, formerly AFIP) agricultural web services. Bundles three SOAP services into a single package with automatic WSAA authentication.

- **WSCPE** - Carta de Porte Electrónica: electronic bill of lading for grain transport
- **WSCTG** - Código de Trazabilidad de Granos: grain traceability codes
- **WSLPG** - Liquidación Primaria de Granos: primary grain settlement and certification

## Architecture

```
ArcaAgro (orchestrator)
├── .cpe  → CpeClient  (WSCPE)  → WSAA service: "wscpe"
├── .ctg  → CtgClient  (WSCTG)  → WSAA service: "wsctg"
└── .lpg  → LpgClient  (WSLPG)  → WSAA service: "wslpg"
```

All shared utilities (WsaaClient, afipSoapCall, errors, types) come from `@ramiidv/arca-common`. No duplication.

## WSAA Service Identifiers

| Service | WSAA ID |
|---------|---------|
| WSCPE   | `wscpe` |
| WSCTG   | `wsctg` |
| WSLPG   | `wslpg` |

## Endpoints

### WSCPE
- Testing: `https://fwshomo.afip.gov.ar/wscpe/services/soap`
- Production: `https://serviciosjava.afip.gob.ar/wscpe/services/soap`

### WSCTG
- Testing: `https://fwshomo.afip.gov.ar/wsctg/services/CTGService_v4.0`
- Production: `https://serviciosjava.afip.gob.ar/wsctg/services/CTGService_v4.0`

### WSLPG
- Testing: `https://fwshomo.afip.gov.ar/wslpg/LpgService`
- Production: `https://serviciosjava.afip.gob.ar/wslpg/LpgService`

## API Methods

### agro.cpe.* (WSCPE)

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `autorizarCPEAutomotor(cpe)` | Authorize electronic bill of lading for road transport |
| `confirmadoArriboCPE(params)` | Confirm arrival at destination |
| `rechazoCPE(params)` | Reject a CPE |
| `anularCPE(params)` | Cancel a CPE |
| `editarCPE(params)` | Edit fields of an authorized CPE |
| `informarContingencia(params)` | Report a contingency on a CPE |
| `consultarCPE(params)` | Query CPEs by search criteria |
| `consultarCPEPorDestino(params)` | Query CPEs by destination |
| `consultarUltNroOrden(sucursal)` | Get last order number for a branch |
| `siguienteNroOrden(sucursal)` | Get next order number (last + 1) |
| `consultarConstanciaCPEPDF(nroCTG)` | Get CPE certificate as base64 PDF |
| `dummy()` | Check WSCPE server status |

### agro.ctg.* (WSCTG)

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `solicitarCTGInicial(solicitud)` | Request initial CTG for grain transport |
| `confirmarArribo(params)` | Confirm CTG arrival at destination |
| `rechazarCTG(params)` | Reject a CTG |
| `anularCTG(params)` | Cancel a CTG |
| `consultarCTG(params)` | Query CTGs by search criteria |
| `consultarCTGExcel(params)` | Query CTGs and get Excel export (base64) |
| `consultarConstanciaCTGPDF(nroCTG)` | Get CTG certificate as base64 PDF |
| `obtenerCTGActivos()` | Get active (pending) CTGs |
| `dummy()` | Check WSCTG server status |

### agro.lpg.* (WSLPG)

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `liquidacionAutorizar(liquidacion)` | Authorize a primary grain settlement |
| `liquidacionConsultar(params)` | Query authorized settlements |
| `liquidacionAnular(ptoEmision, nroOrden)` | Cancel a settlement |
| `liquidacionAjustarUnificado(params)` | Unified adjustment (debit/credit) |
| `certificacionAutorizar(certificacion)` | Authorize a grain certification |
| `certificacionAnular(tipo, nro)` | Cancel a certification |
| `consultarParametros(tipo, params?)` | Query WSLPG parameters (grain types, grades, ports, etc.) |
| `dummy()` | Check WSLPG server status |

### Global

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `serverStatus()` | Check all 3 services at once |
| `clearAuthCache()` | Invalidate all cached WSAA tokens |
| `on(event, handler)` | Subscribe to SDK events |
| `off(event, handler)` | Unsubscribe from events |

## Key Types

### Configuration

```ts
interface ArcaAgroConfig {
  cuit: number;
  cert: string;         // PEM certificate
  key: string;          // PEM private key
  production?: boolean; // default: false
  tokenTTLMinutes?: number;    // default: 720
  requestTimeoutMs?: number;   // default: 30000
  retries?: number;            // default: 1
  retryDelayMs?: number;       // default: 1000
  onEvent?: (event: ArcaEvent) => void;
}
```

### CPE Types

- `CartaPorteAutomotor` - Input for CPE authorization
- `CartaPorteResult` - CPE operation result (nroCTG, nroCartaPorte, estado, errores, raw)
- `ConsultaCPEParams` - CPE query parameters
- `ConfirmadoArriboCPEParams` - Arrival confirmation input
- `RechazoAnulacionCPEParams` - Rejection/cancellation input
- `EditarCPEParams` - Edit input
- `ContingenciaCPEParams` - Contingency report input

### CTG Types

- `SolicitudCTG` - Input for CTG request
- `CTGResult` - CTG operation result (nroCTG, estado, vigencia, errores, raw)
- `ConsultaCTGParams` - CTG query parameters
- `ConfirmarArriboCTGParams` - Arrival confirmation input
- `RechazoCTGParams` - Rejection input
- `AnulacionCTGParams` - Cancellation input
- `CTGActivosResult` - Active CTGs result

### LPG Types

- `Liquidacion` - Input for settlement authorization
- `LiquidacionResult` - Settlement result (codOperacion, nroOrden, totalPagar, errores, raw)
- `ConsultaLiquidacionParams` - Settlement query parameters
- `AjusteUnificadoParams` - Unified adjustment input
- `Certificacion` - Certification input
- `CertificacionResult` - Certification result

## Error Hierarchy

All errors extend from `ArcaError` (from `@ramiidv/arca-common`):

- `ArcaAuthError` - WSAA authentication failures
- `ArcaSoapError` - HTTP/SOAP transport errors (includes `statusCode`)
- `ArcaServiceError` - Business logic errors from ARCA (includes `errors[]` with code + msg)
- `ArcaValidationError` - Input validation errors

## Low-Level Clients

For direct control over auth, use the individual clients:

```ts
import { CpeClient, CtgClient, LpgClient } from '@ramiidv/arca-agro';
import { WsaaClient } from '@ramiidv/arca-common';

const cpe = new CpeClient(production, { timeoutMs, retries, retryDelayMs, onEvent });
const ctg = new CtgClient(production, { ... });
const lpg = new LpgClient(production, { ... });
```

Each client method takes `auth: AgroAuth` as first parameter:
```ts
interface AgroAuth { Token: string; Sign: string; Cuit: number; }
```

## Source Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/constants.ts` | Endpoints, namespaces, WSAA service IDs |
| `src/types.ts` | All TypeScript interfaces for the 3 services |
| `src/cpe-client.ts` | Low-level WSCPE SOAP client |
| `src/ctg-client.ts` | Low-level WSCTG SOAP client |
| `src/lpg-client.ts` | Low-level WSLPG SOAP client |
| `src/arca-agro.ts` | Main orchestrator with auto-auth and namespaced API |
| `src/index.ts` | Public exports |

## Dependencies

- `@ramiidv/arca-common` (^0.1.0) - WsaaClient, afipSoapCall, errors, types, validators
